ios.desc:
TaskFocus makes it very easy to plan things and focus on tasks, as well as track the time spent on them.

The application will be very useful for those who are constantly planning something in their mind, no matter whether it is personal matters or related to your work. TaskFocus is a convenient diary that will not allow your to-do list to get lost, and will also improve your productivity.

Thanks to the application, you can take into account and control the time spent on your good and bad habits.

Our application is a to-do planner that includes the ability to add notes to each task, which will allow you to mark important moments without interrupting your planning or without interrupting focusing on the activity at hand.

Now there will be more space in your head for the most important things, and your plans will not get lost, all thanks to TaskFocus. Using the application you can easily plan your day, week, month or even year.

Features of the "To Do List (Tasks List)" screen:
1. The planner will allow you to plan your activities for any day you choose.
2. Simple and convenient form for adding new tasks.
3. Convenient work with your task list.
4. Convenient task search in the application allows you to find any tasks that are lost. There is a search both by text and by date of tasks.
5. Ability to export tasks and fixed time to an Excel document.

Features of the "Focus on Task" screen:
1. The application allows you to focus on performing a specific task from your list with the ability to select a melody that allows you to better concentrate on the task.
2. Ability to select background sound when focusing for greater immersion.

Features of the "Statistics" screen:
1. The application contains informative statistics on the completion of tasks, their completion time and statistics on an overdue todo list.
2. The ability to export statistics to an Excel document with a breakdown by category and detailed statistics on tasks.

Choice of design:
1. The application supports choosing a design that suits you.

Synchronization:
1. Thanks to the sync of tasks and fixed time, you will always be able to have access to your tasks and time tracking on all your devices.
